```{r}
full_inds <- read_delim("~/Desktop/WAVI/WAVI.breeding.genoscapeAll_climgroup.rm4rel.rm6pop.fixed.incl_16new.txt", col_names = T,delim="\t") %>%
  rename(Sample =sample_name) %>% dplyr::select(-c(bam))
library(openxlsx)
# read metadata for all 261 individuals
full_meta <- read.xlsx("~/Dropbox/BGP/WAVI/WAVI Master06292026.xlsx",sheet=4,detectDates = T) %>% rename(Sample=BGP_ID,latitude=Lat,longitude=Long) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(FullLibraryName,LibraryPlateName,LibraryPlatePosition,Notes,Stage,Population)) %>% 
  filter(Sample %in% full_inds$Sample) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(Sample)
full_inds %>% left_join(full_meta) %>% write.table("WAVI249.GEA.sample_table.csv",row.names=F,quote=F,sep=",")

full_meta<-read_delim("WAVI249.GEA.sample_table.csv",delim=",")

```
  
```{r}
library(sf)
coords_all <- st_as_sf(full_meta, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# we want to transform the coordinates from WGS84 to the Lambert's Projection
if (st_crs(coords_all) != st_crs(landcover)) {
  coords_all <- st_transform(coords_all, crs = st_crs(landcover))
}
crs(landcover) == crs(coords_all)

# define 111.111km (1 degree) further than points
coords_all_bbox <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(coords_all))
coords_all_buffered <- st_buffer(coords_all_bbox, dist = 111111)
landcover_cropped <- terra::crop(landcover, coords_all_buffered) # this may take a little while

reclass_matrix <- matrix(c(
 1, 1,
 2, 1,
 3, 1,
 4, 2,
 5, 2,
 7, 3,
 8, 3,
 9, 4,
 10, 4,
 11, 5,
 12, 5,
 13, 5,
 0, 0,  # keep 0, 6, 14 - 19 the same
 6, 6,
 14, 14,
 15, 15,
 16, 16,
 17, 17,
 18, 18,
 19, 19
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)

# Reclassify the raster
landcover_crop_reclass <- classify(landcover_cropped, reclass_matrix)

new_levels <- data.frame(
 ID = c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6,14,15,16,17,18,19),
 Class_EN = c(
 "No data",
 "Evergreen forest",
 "Deciduous forest",
 "Shrubland",
 "Grassland",
 "Lichen-moss",
 "Mixed Forest",
 "Wetland",
 "Cropland",
 "Barren Land",
 "Urban",
 "Water",
 "Snow and Ice")
)
levels(landcover_crop_reclass) <- list(new_levels)

writeRaster(landcover_crop_reclass, filename = "~/Downloads/land_cover_2020v2_30m_tif/NA_NALCMS_landcover_2020v2_30m/data/landcover_reclass.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

#landcover_crop_reclass <- rast("output/landcover_reclass.tif")

plot(landcover_crop_reclass)
terra::points(vect(coords_all), pch = 2, col = "red")
```


```{r}
coords_all <- coords_all %>% left_join(full_inds, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate()

# create 250m radius buffers
coords_all <- vect(coords_all) # must be spat vector for buffer function.
buffers_all <- terra::buffer(coords_all, width = 250) # radius is in meters

# to avoid resampling cells in overlapping buffers, we want to smush the buffers together
# aggregate by population so that you can take avg land cover per population
buffers_ag_all <- terra::aggregate(buffers_all, by = "Location", dissolve=T)

# plot the buffers across the entire range
plot(landcover_crop_reclass)
plot(buffers_ag_all, add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```
# zoom in on Guadalupe Island??
san_clemente_landcover <- readRDS("../../gea/env-variables/SanClementeIsland_Landcover.rds")
plot(san_clemente_landcover)
plot(buffers_ag_all, add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
pop.buffer.order <- as.data.frame(buffers_ag_all) %>% dplyr::select(Location)

extracted_all <- terra::extract(landcover_crop_reclass, buffers_ag_all, cells = T, df = T, ID=T)

extracted_filt_all <- extracted_all %>% filter(Class_EN!= "No data") %>% rename(Class = Class_EN)

percent_landcover_all <- extracted_filt_all %>%
  group_by(ID, Class) %>%
  tally() %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-n)

percent_landcover_wide_all <- percent_landcover_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Class, values_from = percentage, values_fill = list(percentage = 0))

pland_pops <- cbind(pop.buffer.order, percent_landcover_wide_all) %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

pop_pland_per_ind <- full_meta %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Location) %>% left_join(pland_pops, by = "Location") %>% dplyr::select(-Location)

write_tsv(pop_pland_per_ind, "WAVI.249inds.individual.pland_250m.tsv")
```

## Combine land cover with environment
```{r}
land<-read_delim("WAVI.249inds.individual.pland_250m.tsv",delim="\t") %>%  dplyr::select(Sample,`Evergreen forest`,`Mixed Forest`,Grassland,`Deciduous forest`) %>% rename(EvergreenForest=`Evergreen forest`,MixedForest=`Mixed Forest`,Deciduous=`Deciduous forest`)
env<-read_delim("WAVI.249.Chelsa.elev_tree.txt",delim="\t")
hii<-read_csv("WAVI_Human_Impact_Buffer_Statistics_from_2005.csv") %>% rename(HumanImpact_mean=mean,HumanImpact_sum=sum) %>% dplyr::select(Sample,Region2,MapNum3,HumanImpact_mean,HumanImpact_sum)
ndvi<-read_csv("WAVI_Points_NDVI_Extraction.csv") %>% group_by(Sample) %>% summarise(NDVI_mean=mean(NDVI))
cbind(land,env) %>% left_join(hii) %>% left_join(ndvi) %>%  
  dplyr::select(Sample,Region2,Long,Lat,everything()) %>% 
  write.table("WAVI.env_pland_ndvi.249ind.txt",row.names=F,quote=F,sep="\t")


cbind(land,env) %>% left_join(hii) %>% left_join(ndvi) %>%  
  dplyr::select(Sample,Region2,MapNum3,Long,Lat,everything()) %>% 
  filter(MapNum3 %notin% c("AD","AV","AY","AZ","BA","BB","BC","BD","BE","A","B","AW")) %>%
  write.table("WAVI.env_pland_ndvi.200ind.West_SW_SD_Hyb.csv",row.names=F,quote=F,sep=",")
```
## If there's a missing population, do this
```
missing_pop <- "LOSH_BAJA_2"
missing_buffer <- buffers_ag_all[buffers_ag_all$population == missing_pop, ]

missing_buffer_sf <- st_as_sf(missing_buffer)

# Create a ~1 degree buffer around it (approx 111 km)
zoom_buffer <- st_buffer(missing_buffer_sf, dist = 51111)  # meters

# Convert back to terra extent for cropping raster
zoom_ext <- ext(as_Spatial(zoom_buffer))  # terra expects Spat* objects or extent

# Crop the landcover raster
landcover_crop_zoom <- crop(landcover_crop_reclass, zoom_ext)

# Plot
plot(landcover_crop_zoom, main = paste("Zoomed ~1° around", missing_pop))
plot(missing_buffer, add = TRUE, border = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(zoom_buffer$geometry, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)

```
